sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Four release checks from majkinetor's Platform Check and Mission Control now show in the ⚠️ WARNING / ❌ ERROR menus, the 📊 Findings sections and as a cell tint on release lists (release group, artist, label, series and tag pages), with no extra requests: an all-zero barcode such as 000000000000 (❌, it passes the format check), a release with no barcode entered (an empty cell; "[none]" is not flagged; counted in the menu, its tint is off by default), a label without a catalog number ("[no label]" excepted) and a release with neither a date nor a country. Each tint has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings.
